manifest.method: After attempt mint, compile the exact source bytes pinned below but execute no CLI main. In fresh namespaces, require untouched selftest before and after. For each frozen row, require transform_screen to emit the exact target-named collapse; in a new namespace replace only that PAIRWISE_TRANSFORMS member with identity and, for the seven shared base transforms, replace the same TRANSFORMS member; require the fresh finding to disappear; then require selftest to fail and its AssertionError text to contain the exact registry member name. manifest.analysis_plan: File once if both untouched controls pass, the exact nine-member registry is present, every source-finding and mutation completes, and every namespace is fresh. Abort rather than file on source drift, registry drift, untouched failure, unexpected exception type, or incomplete table.
